selection: All two late-mother conflicts and random six of twenty early-daughter conflicts; random.Random(20261103), sorted IDs, fixed before follow-up answers.
point_rule: Nearest integer pixel via floor(x+0.5), exact containing full training segmentation ID; no snapping, neighborhood search or tolerance.
identity_rule: Mother equals programmed parent; unordered daughter IDs equal the two programmed daughters. Corrected labels are the primary training-label check; original labels are descriptive.
uncertainty_rule: All eight remain in denominator; uncertain/lost, missing points, background and other assigned identities are separate. No imputation.
inference: Conditional eight-case diagnostic only. No population accuracy estimate or significance test; no pooling with the original 17/39 to estimate accuracy.
